title: Reading FreeSurfer stats files
text: recon-finishes, subject stats/ folder parcellation data. read_freesurfer_stats() reads one file time: hemisphere encoded filename (lh. rh.). match atlas, prepend label column:
code: subjects_dir <- Sys.getenv("SUBJECTS_DIR") stats_file <- file.path(subjects_dir, "bert/stats/lh.aparc.stats")  data <- read_freesurfer_stats(stats_file) data ggplot() +   geom_brain(     atlas = dk(),     data = data |> mutate(label = paste0("lh_", label)),     mapping = aes(fill = ThickAvg)   )

title: Reading FreeSurfer stats files
text: read_atlas_files() reads matching stats files subjects directory. Pass regular expression select right files: trailing $ matters – ensures get aparc.stats aparc.a2009s.stats. function adds hemisphere prefixes automatically, data ready plotting: show metrics , pivot facet:
code: dat <- read_atlas_files(subjects_dir, "aparc.stats$") dat ggplot() +   geom_brain(atlas = dk(), data = dat, mapping = aes(fill = ThickStd)) library(tidyr)  long <- dat |>   pivot_longer(-c(subject, label), names_to = "stat", values_to = "val")  ggplot() +   geom_brain(     atlas = dk(),     data = group_by(long, stat),     mapping = aes(fill = val)   ) +   facet_wrap(~stat)

title: Reading FreeSurfer stats files
text: FreeSurfer’s aparcstats2table asegstats2table commands create summary tables across subjects. Read read_freesurfer_table(): output three columns: subject, label, value.
code: table_path <- "path/to/aparc.volume.table"  read_freesurfer_table(table_path)

title: Reading FreeSurfer stats files
text: Stats tables append measure name label (e.g. lh_bankssts_volume). measure argument strips suffix renames value column:
code: dat <- read_freesurfer_table(table_path, measure = "volume") dat

title: Reading FreeSurfer stats files
text: FreeSurfer tables include summary measures (total volume, ICV) don’t correspond atlas regions. Filter plotting: grepl("lh|rh", label) pattern keeps hemisphere-specific rows.
code: ggplot() +   geom_brain(     atlas = dk(),     data = dat |> filter(grepl("lh|rh", label)),     mapping = aes(fill = volume)   )

title: ggseg 3.0.0
text: Region keys changed. ggseg.formats re-keyed bundled atlases: region column now holds short keys (e.g. "superiorparietal", "transversetemporal") fully spelled-names moved new names column. user data joined atlas region must re-keyed. Passing long name region expected longer matches, geom_brain() warns rows merged. ggseg.formats ships helper translating old keys new — look legacy_region_map() ggseg.formats reference — join schema-stable label column instead. ggseg now requires ggseg.formats (>= 0.0.4.9008); combination older ggseg re-keyed atlases silently wrong, new floor rules . GeomBrain different object. 2.2.1 3.0.0 export GeomBrain, longer ggproto: now polygon geom (GeomBrain < ggplot2::GeomPolygon < ggplot2::Geom) backs default geom_brain(). sf geom used now GeomBrainSf, release also exports extension code ggplot2::layer(geom = GeomBrain) sf path migration target: switch GeomBrainSf. export name change, failure mode extension code confusing rendering error rather object--found error — check package reaches GeomBrain directly. geom_brain() gained fun argument, positionally show.legend. signature now geom_brain(mapping, data, atlas, hemi, view, position, context, fun, show.legend, inherit.aes, ...). Callers passing show.legend inherit.aes positionally shift one — name arguments. Multiple data rows per region now combined, overplotted. fun (default mean) reduces within facet panel. Long data several rows per region — one per subject, say — used overplot, last row silently won; now averaged. silent numeric change anyone plotting unaggregated cohort, geom_brain() warns per session fun actually collapses rows. Pass fun = dplyr::last recover old last-wins behaviour. fun applies numeric columns — non-numeric columns take first value group regardless. aes() mappings x, y, group, subgroup ignored, warning. derived atlas geometry (group polygon feature id, subgroup marks holes), mapping previously corrupted rendering silently — aes(group = region) collapsed region’s separate polygon pieces. Polygon draw order now follows data’s row order. used atlas’s polygon order regardless data, mapped variable colour outlines stacked order unrelated . Regions now draw order appear data (later rows top); regions supply value stay underneath atlas order. arrange() data control layering. Visual-, restacks overlapping outlines (#162). position_brain() ignores hemi term slice-based atlases (subcortical, cerebellar, tract), warning. views whole slices already containing hemispheres, hemi ~ view longer splits grey context row away structures. view now renders anatomical context integrated, matching plot(). Subcortical tract plots using hemi ~ view lay differently (correctly).
